#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Final edge-case sweep."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import bridge as B
FAIL = []; COUNT = [0]
def check(name, cond, detail=''):
    COUNT[0] += 1
    if not cond: FAIL.append(name); print('FAIL', name, str(detail)[:500])
def run(routes, events): return B.bridge({'routes': routes, 'events': events})
def H(sid, fields): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': fields}
def D(sid, hx): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': hx}
def U(sid, ft, hx): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': ft, 'hex': hx}
def F(sid): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'}
def R(sid): return {'sid': sid, 'type': 'reset'}
def hdr(sid=0, method='GET', scheme='https', auth='demo.test', path='/', extra=()):
    f = [[':method', method], [':scheme', scheme], [':authority', auth], [':path', path]]; f.extend(extra); return H(sid, f)
RT = {'https://demo.test': 'a', 'https://[::1]': 'b', 'https://[::ffff:192.0.2.1]': 'c',
      'http://a-b.c-d.e': 'd', 'https://1.2.3.4.5': 'e'}
def pipe(r, l='a'): return bytes.fromhex(r['origins'][l])
def st(r, i=0): return r['streams'][i]

# all-zero huge content-length matches empty body
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length', '0'*5000]]), F(0)])
check('cl-allzeros', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and pipe(r).endswith(b'content-length: 0\r\n\r\n'), st(r))
# pseudo-only authority (no method) rejected
check('auth-only', run(RT, [H(0, [[':authority','demo.test']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
# te without trailers still consumed, content-length framing
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['te','trailers'],['x-z','1']]), D(0,'41ff'), F(0)])
check('te-no-trailer', pipe(r) == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-z: 1\r\ncontent-length: 2\r\n\r\nA\xff', pipe(r))
# cookie last position
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['x-1','a'],['x-2','b'],['cookie','k=v']]), F(0)])
check('cookie-last', pipe(r) == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-1: a\r\nx-2: b\r\ncookie: k=v\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n', pipe(r))
# many cookies joined in order
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['cookie','1'],['cookie','2'],['cookie','3'],['cookie','4'],['cookie','5']]), F(0)])
check('cookie-many', b'cookie: 1; 2; 3; 4; 5\r\n' in pipe(r), pipe(r))
# IPv4-mapped IPv6 canonical
r = run(RT, [hdr(auth='[::FFFF:c000:201]'), F(0)])
check('v4mapped', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and st(r)['origin'] == 'c' and st(r)['cache_key'][2] == '[::ffff:192.0.2.1]', st(r))
r = run(RT, [hdr(auth='[0:0:0:0:0:ffff:c000:201]:443'), F(0)])
check('v4mapped-long', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and st(r)['cache_key'][2] == '[::ffff:192.0.2.1]', st(r))
# dns with digits/hyphens and http scheme
r = run(RT, [hdr(scheme='http', auth='A-B.C-D.E:080'), F(0)])
check('dns-hyphen', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and st(r)['origin'] == 'd' and st(r)['cache_key'][2] == 'a-b.c-d.e', st(r))
# five-label digits is a DNS name
r = run(RT, [hdr(auth='1.2.3.4.5'), F(0)])
check('five-labels', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and st(r)['origin'] == 'e', st(r))
# port edge values
check('port-00000', run(RT, [hdr(auth='demo.test:00000'), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
r = run({'https://demo.test:1':'a'}, [hdr(auth='demo.test:00001'), F(0)])
check('port-00001', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded' and st(r)['cache_key'][2] == 'demo.test:1', st(r))
check('port-65535-5dig', run({'https://demo.test:65535':'a'}, [hdr(auth='demo.test:65535'), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'forwarded')
# mixed-case percent escapes preserved
r = run(RT, [hdr(path='/a%2fB%2Fc?x=%Fa'), F(0)])
check('escape-case', pipe(r).startswith(b'GET /a%2fB%2Fc?x=%FA HTTP/1.1\r\n'.hex()) or pipe(r).startswith(b'GET /a%2fB%2Fc?x=%Fa HTTP/1.1\r\n'), pipe(r)[:60])
check('escape-key', st(r)['cache_key'][3] == '/a%2fB%2Fc?x=%Fa', st(r))
# unknown-frame-only stream then FIN is rejected; then RESET cancels
check('unknown-fin', run(RT, [U(0,33,''), U(0,999999,'ffee'*100), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
check('unknown-reset', run(RT, [U(0,33,''), R(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'cancelled')
# trailer dedup + repetitions preserved
r = run(RT, [hdr(), D(0,'ff'), H(0,[['x-audit-s','1'],['x-audit-t','2'],['x-audit-s','3'],['x-audit-s','']]), F(0)])
exp = (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
       b'trailer: x-audit-s, x-audit-t\r\n\r\n1\r\n\xff\r\n0\r\n'
       b'x-audit-s: 1\r\nx-audit-t: 2\r\nx-audit-s: 3\r\nx-audit-s: \r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-dedup', pipe(r) == exp, pipe(r))
# content-length members with tabs inside list
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['content-length','\t7\t,\t 7']]), D(0,'41'*7), F(0)])
check('cl-tabs', st(r)['status'] == 'forwarded', st(r))
# body containing pseudo chunk framing lookalikes stays body
body = b'0\r\n\r\nGET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 5\r\n\r\nAAAAA'
r = run(RT, [hdr(method='POST'), D(0, body.hex()), H(0,[['x-audit-q','1']]), F(0)])
exp = (b'POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-q\r\n\r\n'
       + b'%x\r\n' % len(body) + body + b'\r\n0\r\nx-audit-q: 1\r\n\r\n')
check('smuggle-body', pipe(r) == exp, pipe(r))
# zero-length DATA events only
r = run(RT, [hdr(method='POST'), D(0,''), D(0,''), H(0,[]), F(0)])
check('empty-data-trailer', pipe(r) == b'POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n', pipe(r))
# interleaved: rejected stream between two forwarded on the same origin
ev = [hdr(0, path='/1'), hdr(4, path='//bad'), hdr(8, path='/3'), F(8), F(4), F(0)]
r = run(RT, ev)
p = pipe(r)
check('interleave-mixed', p == (b'GET /3 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
      b'GET /1 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
      and [s['status'] for s in r['streams']] == ['forwarded','rejected','forwarded']
      and [s['offset'] for s in r['streams']] == [67, None, 0]
      and [s['commit_at'] for s in r['streams']] == [5, None, 4], (r['streams'], p))
# large sid values and sid ordering
r = run(RT, [hdr(4611686018427387900, path='/hi'), F(4611686018427387900), hdr(0), F(0)])
check('huge-sid-sort', [s['sid'] for s in r['streams']] == [0, 4611686018427387900], r['streams'])
# authority via host only, canonical host line
r = run(RT, [H(0, [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','demo.test:443']]), F(0)])
check('host-canonical', pipe(r).startswith(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\n') and st(r)['cache_key'][2] == 'demo.test', pipe(r))
# path only '/' with query, method HEAD
r = run(RT, [hdr(method='HEAD', path='/?a=1&b=2'), F(0)])
check('head-query', pipe(r).startswith(b'HEAD /?a=1&b=2 HTTP/1.1\r\n'.hex()), pipe(r)[:40])
# empty regular value and empty cookie join position with other repeats
r = run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['accept',''],['accept','text/html'],['vary','*'],['vary','accept-encoding']]), F(0)])
exp = (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\naccept: \r\naccept: text/html\r\nvary: *\r\n'
       b'vary: accept-encoding\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('repeat-empty', pipe(r) == exp, pipe(r))
# singleton repeated among list fields
check('mixed-dup', run(RT, [hdr(extra=[['accept','a'],['x-s','1'],['accept','b'],['x-s','2']]), F(0)])['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected')
print('checks:', COUNT[0], 'failures:', len(FAIL))
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)
